arg.name: setup_path
arg.description: Path to clearpath-generated description directory (must contain robot.urdf.xacro from generate_description)

arg.name: map
arg.description: Full path to the occupancy-map yaml file

arg.name: params_file
arg.description: Full path to the Nav2 parameters file

arg.name: use_sim_time
arg.description: Use simulation (Omniverse Isaac Sim) clock if true

let.name: robot_description
let.value: $(command '$(find-exec xacro) "$(var setup_path)/robot.urdf.xacro" is_sim:=true gazebo_controllers:="$(var setup_path)/platform/config/control.yaml" namespace:="$(var namespace)" use_fake_hardware:=true use_platform_controllers:=false use_manipulation_controllers:=false')
